name: Rails authentication generator

evidence.library: F02: generator writes login and account code into the developer's Rails app; F05: developer runs the app and database

line: Rails generator for a starting point with login and password recovery.

free.text: Free MIT generator; you run the app

cells.freeUsers: No licence user cap; you host
cells.sso: No SSO or SCIM connection product

mau.math: The Rails software licence costs $0. Hosting, database and email delivery for the generated app cost extra.
